# UCI Energy Efficiency data

- Source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, “Energy Efficiency” (DOI: 10.24432/C51307).
- Downloaded: 2026-09-06 from `https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/242/data.csv`.
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
- Local file: `uci_energy_efficiency.csv`.
- SHA-256: `db44dbe453acd464b5cf65be2fb01a28aa9c5b2630300e65fbe28cde35f5d96f`.

The manuscript uses three all-minimisation objectives: surface area (`X2`),
heating load (`Y1`), and cooling load (`Y2`). Duplicate objective profiles are
removed before Pareto filtering. This is a reproducible application-oriented
simulation benchmark, not field or stakeholder validation.
